── Cisco/Viptela legacy SD-WAN (vtbond/vtedge/vtsmart image folder naming) ──────
Unlike the "cisco-catc*"/"cisco-vtmgmt" keys above (which only match names that
carry an explicit "cisco-" vendor prefix), these three images are catalogued on
this platform WITHOUT that prefix - image-manager's unpacked-folder auto-detector
names them straight off their folder ("vtbond-16.2.11" -> record.name "vtbond",
same for vtedge/vtsmart; confirmed live via GET /api/v1/images). None of the
"cisco-vt*" keys above ever matched these three real images (verified with
get_profile_key() against the live records: "vtedge" -> None before this fix,
"cisco-catc8k-1.0" -> "cisco-catc" for comparison) - they silently fell through to
GENERIC_KVM_PROFILE (512 MB / 1 vCPU) every time, an 8x CPU shortfall for vEdge vs.
the certified matrix in docs/platform/node-emulation.md (Cisco SD-WAN & Management
table). Keyed WITHOUT the "cisco-" prefix so they match both this platform's actual
bare naming and a "cisco-vtedge-..." style name if one is ever imported (substring
match, see get_profile() docstring) - "vtedge"/"vtbond"/"vtsmart" don't collide with
any other key ("catvedge" - the newer Catalyst SD-WAN vEdge - does NOT contain the
substring "vtedge", confirmed).

reasons.vendor: rule #59 reason: ram 2048 / cpu 2 vs EVE 1024 / 1 - Viptela vBond vendor minimum (2 GB, 2 vCPU), enforced by min_enforcement below; EVE default is below vendor floor.
reasons.config_dialect:
NPX-818 (Wave 21 U3): Cisco's SD-WAN (Viptela) boxes carry vendor "cisco", which
sent every one of them to VENDOR_CLI["cisco"] - IOS verbs. Viptela is not IOS: it
is a confd CLI whose configuration mode is entered with "config", committed with
"commit and-quit" and paged off with "paginate false", and whose "end"/"write
memory" equivalents do not exist. VENDOR_CLI already carries the correct
"viptela" dialect (authored and live-proved in an earlier wave); nothing ever
reached it, because a dialect is only selected by the vendor string unless a
profile names it. This is the same shape as NPX-617 (IOS-XR reached the IOS
dialect through vendor "cisco" and silently lost every config), so it is fixed
the same way and for the same reason.
